launches.title: Ornith-1.0-9B and Ornith-1.0-35B models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
launches.excerpt: DeepReinforce AI models Ornith-1.0-9B and Ornith-1.0-35B are now accessible on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for AWS customers. These open-source agentic coding models are released under the MIT licence and belong to the Ornith 1.0 family. They achieve state-of-the-art performance for open-source models of similar sizes across benchmarks such as Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-Bench, NL2Repo, and OpenClaw. The Ornith-1.0-9B variant is a lightweight dense model with nine billion parameters, post-trained on Qwen 3.5 9B and tailored for single-GPU deployment. It features a 256K-token context window and thirty-two decoder layers, making it suitable for individual developers and small teams operating on consumer-grade hardware. The Ornith-1.0-35B model uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with thirty-five billion parameters, likewise post-trained on Qwen 3.5 to deliver enhanced agentic coding capabilities while remaining deployable on a single 24GB consumer GPU. launches.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash models now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
launches.excerpt: Three new open-weight Mixture-of-Experts language models from DeepSeek have been made available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for AWS customers. Released under the MIT license, the DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash models provide high efficiency by activating only a fraction of their total parameters per token while delivering strong performance in reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads. DeepSeek-V4-Pro is a flagship 1.6-trillion-parameter model that activates 49 billion parameters per token and features a one-million-token context window for complex reasoning and long-document analysis. DeepSeek-V4-Flash offers an efficient alternative for latency-sensitive tasks as a 284-billion-parameter model that activates 13 billion parameters per token while maintaining the same one-million-token context window. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash introduces native multimodal support using a Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture with a 552-billion-parameter backbone. This model activates eight billion parameters during prefill and sixteen billion during decode, and it supports a one-million-token context window alongside 384,000 maximum output tokens. launches.title: AWS Network Security Manager now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud and Additional New Regions
launches.excerpt: AWS Network Security Manager is now generally available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud Region alongside thirty-one additional regions worldwide. The service is a comprehensive network security management solution designed to simplify the deployment and enforcement of security policies at scale. Within the European Sovereign Cloud Region, the tool specifically supports AWS WAF and AWS Shield. The thirty-one newly added locations include US East (Ohio), multiple Asia Pacific regions ranging from Mumbai to Tokyo, several European hubs such as Frankfurt and London, Canada, Mexico, Israel, South America, and Africa. Network Security Manager features always-on security deployment automation that applies AWS WAF protection directly to internet-facing assets like the AWS Application Load Balancer. This automated capability allows security teams to manage WAF rules and AWS Shield Advanced protections more efficiently across targeted accounts and resources. Administrators can use the platform to centrally manage security policies, automatically detect configuration drift, and apply remediation. The service aims to reduce the operational overhead associated with manual security management while maintaining a consistent security posture. Users can consult the AWS Region Table to verify specific regional availability. Detailed pricing information can be found on the AWS Network Security Manager Pricing page for standard regions and on the European Sovereign Cloud Pricing page.

launches.title: AWS Emulator is now available for building and testing AWS applications locally
launches.excerpt: Amazon Web Services has launched AWS Emulator, a new tool designed for building and testing applications locally on a personal computer or within a continuous integration environment. The tool allows developers and automated coding agents to execute existing AWS SDK and CLI commands locally without needing an active AWS account or making cloud deployments. Responses are returned in milliseconds, and the software maintains resource state in memory until it is stopped. Separate instances of the emulator each receive distinct ports, cryptographic keys, and isolated state environments, ensuring that concurrent jobs, test suites, and agents do not interfere with one another. For supported operations, the emulator replicates the exact success outcomes and error messages generated by live AWS services, while unsupported operations currently return a 501 Not Implemented status. The underlying services are generated directly from the official API models published by AWS, meaning new services and updates can be incorporated over time. Developers can consult an online fidelity report to compare the emulator responses directly against real AWS behavior. Operating independently of any geographical AWS Region, the tool incurs no additional service fees, meaning users only pay for cloud resources once they deploy to production. The source code for AWS Emulator is publicly available under a CC0 1.0 Universal dedication, and documentation has been published to help users get started.

launches.title: AWS Quick apps are now available in Asia Pacific (Singapore)
launches.excerpt: The AWS Quick desktop application for macOS and Windows, alongside the Quick mobile application for iOS and Android, has become available in the Asia Pacific Singapore Region. This regional launch follows the recent general availability of Quick within Singapore. The desktop application is designed to integrate with local files while connecting directly to calendars, emails, and various business applications. Meanwhile, the mobile application enables users to chat with Quick, check their activity feeds, and open dashboards while away from their computers. A key feature of the software is that conversations, context, and agents remain synchronized across the web, desktop, and mobile platforms. This synchronization allows users to initiate an agent on a desktop computer, monitor its progress from a smartphone, and ensure that tasks continue running even after the primary computer is shut down. geo.title: ‘I had the courage to believe in Mississippi’ says Scott Colom after historic Senate win – US politics live
geo.excerpt: Mississippi has elected Democrat Scott Colom as its US senator, contributing to a series of Democratic gains during the midterm elections. Colom defeated the incumbent Republican senator, Cindy Hyde-Smith, in a closely contested race. His victory makes him the first black senator from Mississippi since the post-Civil War Reconstruction era, representing a significant breakthrough for the Democratic Party in a traditionally Republican state. The Associated Press called the election result just over a week after polling day, following the counting of absentee and provisional ballots. In his victory speech, Colom stated that he had the courage to imagine the outcome and to believe in Mississippi. Hyde-Smith acknowledged the result, stating that she respected the decision of the state's voters despite it not being the outcome she worked for. Meanwhile, US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow for discussions with Vladimir Putin regarding the war in Ukraine, following earlier negotiations in Abu Dhabi. Separately, US defence secretary Pete Hegseth was reprimanded by a military guard for laughing and talking near the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, an incident that occurred shortly after Republicans blocked an attempt to impeach him.

geo.title: Missing teenager found in bushland during aerial search in Australia
geo.excerpt: A seventeen-year-old teenager has been found alive in dense bushland in Australia following a six-day search operation. The youth had initially been camping with a friend when he left the campsite to retrieve some equipment and failed to return. When he did not come back, emergency services were alerted, prompting a search of the surrounding area. The multi-day operation involved ground crews, police personnel, and aerial support units scanning the difficult terrain. During an aerial sweep of the dense vegetation, search teams successfully located the missing camper. Rescuers subsequently reached the teenager in the bushland to assess his condition and coordinate his extraction. invest.title: Nebius falls 16% as company expects increased 2026 capex spend, issues weak outlook
invest.excerpt: Nebius shares fell 16% on Thursday after the neocloud company issued a disappointing outlook and higher capital expenditure forecasts, overshadowing third-quarter revenue that beat analysts' estimates. Revenue surged 571% during the quarter, while the company reported a net loss of $37.5 million, or 13 cents per share, compared to a net loss of $119.6 million, or 50 cents per share, in the same period last year. In a letter to shareholders, CEO Arkady Volozh stated that fiscal year 2026 revenue is expected to land at the low end of a $3 billion to $3.4 billion range. Nebius also provided an initial 2027 revenue outlook of $12 billion to $13 billion. The company anticipates fiscal year 2026 capital expenditures of $27 billion, which exceeds its previous guidance of $20 billion to $25 billion. Furthermore, expected capital expenditures for 2027 are projected to be between $40 billion and $45 billion, significantly higher than market expectations. The stock decline also coincided with the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, with Nvidia holding approximately $329 million in Nebius shares at the end of June. During the quarter, Nebius successfully raised $5.75 billion in debt financing. Executives planned to discuss the financial results and provide further guidance during a conference call with analysts.

invest.title: Claude chatbot maker set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
invest.excerpt: Anthropic, the artificial intelligence company behind the Claude chatbot, is preparing for a stock market debut on New York's Nasdaq exchange that could value the firm at around $1.3 trillion. The loss-making company plans to offer shares priced between $70 and $78 each to raise up to $64 billion during its float this month. This valuation falls below some earlier predictions of $2 trillion made by backers during the summer. The listing occurs during a volatile period for big tech firms, following a sharp fall on the Nasdaq after US midterm elections amid concerns that a Democrat-led Congress might slow artificial intelligence development and data centre expansion.
